title: Exhibitionism
details: So what if Lara’s an exhibitionist? If she wants to do her yoga routine outdoors in a skimpy workout clothes, it’s not like she’s doing anything vulgar. But Lara is so good at getting attention she inspires an observer to do the same… and screwing his wife loud enough for Lara to hear it through the wall just might be a calling card for these two showoffs to put on a performance together.
